canDoYue: 你識同同事講週末同天氣，再轉去開會。
canDoEn: Talk about the weekend and the weather, then start the meeting.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: Good morning Tom. How was your weekend, and was the weather very bright on Saturday?
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨 Tom。你週末點呀，星期六天氣係咪好晴？
dialogue.say: Good morning Tom. How was your weekend, and was the weather very bright on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The weekend was busy, and I spent Saturday with my sister in a quiet cafe.
dialogue.glossYue: 週末好忙，我星期六同家姐去咗一間靜嘅咖啡店。
dialogue.say: The weekend was busy, and I spent Saturday with my sister in a quiet cafe.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: Same here. My commute was long, but the coffee on the way was warm and good.
dialogue.glossYue: 我都係。通勤好長，不過路途嗰杯咖啡又暖又好飲。
dialogue.say: Same here. My commute was long, but the coffee on the way was warm and good.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Not bad at all. By the way, are you ready for the meeting with the team?
dialogue.glossYue: 都唔差。順便問吓，你準備好同團隊開會未？
dialogue.say: Not bad at all. By the way, are you ready for the meeting with the team?

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: I am ready. Shall we catch up later, and start the meeting in the room?
dialogue.glossYue: 我準備好。我哋遲啲再傾，然後喺房入面開會？
dialogue.say: I am ready. Shall we catch up later, and start the meeting in the room?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Yes. The weekend was quiet, and I am ready when the team is in the room.
dialogue.glossYue: 好。週末好靜，團隊入到房我就準備好。
dialogue.say: Yes. The weekend was quiet, and I am ready when the team is in the room.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: My commute was very slow, but the coffee helped, and the weather stayed bright.
dialogue.glossYue: 我通勤好慢，不過咖啡有幫助，天氣都係好晴。
dialogue.say: My commute was very slow, but the coffee helped, and the weather stayed bright.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Shall we go in? I am ready, and we can catch up later after the meeting.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋入去？我準備好，開完會可以遲啲再傾。
dialogue.say: Shall we go in? I am ready, and we can catch up later after the meeting.
